method: AI visual scope screening of all 236 contact-sheet images, selected individual enlargements; not full-text/human verification
limitations: Content-style screening is not a verified transcription or label audit.
English-only, payment and taxonomy questions remain independent quality gates.
Held originals are excluded until a separately reviewed printed-only derivative exists.
Incidental signatures are not transcription targets; no signature-recognition guarantee is made for legacy OCR.
Existing legacy model is not retrained under printed-only scope.
